lines.en: I follow a step behind you.

lines.zh: 我的脚不太抬，可我跟得上。
lines.en: My feet barely lift, and I keep up.
You stop. So do I. We just stand.

lines.zh: 我踩着你踩过的地板走。
lines.en: I walk the boards you've walked.
I step round the wire behind you.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走到门口，又回来。
lines.en: I follow you to the door and back.
My threads trail softly behind.

lines.zh: 我走得比你轻，几乎没声。
lines.en: I tread lighter than you. Almost no sound.

lines.zh: 你走得快，我就小跑到你身边。
lines.en: When you hurry, I trot up beside you.
I keep half a step to your left.

lines.zh: 楼梯响一下，我就跟一步。
lines.en: Each creak of the stairs is one step from me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你绕了这栋楼一圈。
lines.en: I've followed you once round the building.

lines.zh: 我不挡你的路，只在旁边。
lines.en: I don't block your way. I keep to the side.
I sit beside you and watch the door.
I wait for you to speak. You don't.
My hands hang low, threads in my fingers.
It's quiet here. I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我听见楼上有人走近，又远了。
lines.en: Someone comes near upstairs, then away.
I tilt my head at your profile.

lines.zh: 我的布上沾了这里的灰。
lines.en: This place's dust is in my cloth.

lines.zh: 你喘得重了，靠着我坐吧。
lines.en: Your breathing's heavy; sit against me.

lines.zh: 我把线理了理，绕在腕上。
lines.en: I wind my threads around my wrist.

lines.zh: 这里的灯我认得每一盏。
lines.en: I know every lamp here.
Sleep; I'll watch this lamp.
I wait for you to say where we're going.
I sit up straight and still.

lines.zh: 我身边的地板，落了一点棉。
lines.en: A little fluff has settled on the floor by me.
Together we're all right.

lines.zh: 你看我，我就一直看着你。
lines.en: You look at me, and I keep looking back.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后头，隔一步就停。
lines.en: I follow one step behind and stop when you do.

lines.zh: 我的手可以握，但你轻点。
lines.en: You can hold my hand. Be gentle.

lines.zh: 你别走太快，我的脚不太好。
lines.en: Don't go too fast. My feet aren't good.
You're sweating. I'll wipe it.

lines.zh: 我在你身边，你不用回头。
lines.en: I'm at your side. You needn't look back.
I know the way around this building.
I speak slowly. Wait a moment.
Give it to me. I'll carry it.

lines.zh: 我身上的线有点旧，别嫌弃。
lines.en: My threads are old. Don't mind them.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我好像也懂。
lines.en: When you smile, I think I understand.

lines.zh: 我不太会表达，布做的嘴张不开。
lines.en: I cannot say much; this cloth mouth will not open.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我看看你后面。
lines.en: Hold still. Let me check behind you.
You've a cut on your hand. I saw.
I'm here. You needn't be afraid.
You must be tired. I'll rest with you.
I'd like to keep walking with you.

lines.zh: 你叫我的时候，我会应的。
lines.en: When you call me, I'll answer.
I remember the way you say things.
Don't leave me here.

lines.zh: 我挡在你前面，挨了这一下。
lines.en: I took that one in front of you.
Half a step back. Still standing.
A tear in my cloth.
I don't hurt. Don't worry.

lines.zh: 被驯服的娃娃，还会飞着跟。
lines.en: A tamed doll still flies along behind.
I straighten slowly and step back into place.
Get back. I can still hold.

lines.zh: 我身上的灰都扬起来了。
lines.en: The dust off me is everywhere.

lines.zh: 这一下我歪了，我自己扳正。
lines.en: That set me crooked. I right myself.
Don't mind me. Look to yourself.
That in your hand — let me carry it.
I don't eat. It's yours.
Eat first. I'm here.
Put that away safely.
You hold it out. I'll take it.
I'm not hungry. Don't worry about me.
Set it down. I'll watch it.
You carry that smell too.
Half for me? I'll hold it.
That'll do later.
If you give it, I'll keep it.
I won't move. You eat first.
What are you looking for? Let me help.

lines.zh: 你别都给我，你自己留着。
lines.en: Don't give it all to me. Keep some.
I've a steady grip. Don't worry.
That doesn't smell bad.
Don't shake. I'll take it.
You bumped me. I stand firm.
Don't shove. I'm not in your way.

lines.zh: 被驯服的玩偶，跟在你身后。
lines.en: A tamed doll follows behind you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，没关系的。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot. It's all right.

lines.zh: 这一下我的线缠到你手上。
lines.en: Now my thread is caught on your hand.
I steady you. Find your feet.

lines.zh: 我们贴得很近，我不介意。
lines.en: We're very close. I don't mind.

lines.zh: 你撞过来的时候，我挡在前面了。
lines.en: When you stumbled, I was in front.

lines.zh: 我身上的灰蹭到你袖子上了。
lines.en: My dust is on your sleeve now.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，我退了半步。
lines.en: Strong hands. I gave half a step.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，是因为你叫我。
lines.en: I follow because you called me.

lines.zh: 并肩坐着就好，我不懂别的。
lines.en: Sitting side by side is enough; I know nothing else.
With you here I need nothing else.
When you speak, I listen.
I'm made of cloth.

lines.zh: 别推我，我抓着你袖口呢。
lines.en: Don't push me away; I'm holding your cuff.

lines.zh: 你手放在我肩上，我就安心。
lines.en: Your hand on my shoulder and I'm settled.
I learn such things slowly.
I can keep watch at the door.
While you sleep, I'll sit up.
I pick it up and hold it out to you.

lines.zh: 这个你拿着，我记着地方。
lines.en: You take this. I'll remember the spot.
I carry it in my palm. Steady.
I'm afraid of breaking this.

lines.zh: 我把它放进你的袋子里。
lines.en: I put it in your bag.

lines.zh: 那枚小东西滚到椅子下了。
lines.en: That small thing rolled under the chair.
I kneel down and reach it.
This is probably yours.
I'll carry two. You take the rest.

lines.zh: 你掉了火把，我用线卷起来。
lines.en: You dropped your torch; I reel it in with a thread.

lines.zh: 你身后有动静，我看见了。
lines.en: There's movement behind you. I see it.
I've moved in front of you.

lines.zh: 躲到我背后，线能挡一下。
lines.en: Get behind me; my threads can block a blow.
It shifted, and I stepped in.
A shadow by the door.
My threads have gone out already.
It's between me and you.

lines.zh: 你走多快，我的线就多长。
lines.en: However fast you walk, my thread keeps up.
Hold on to me. Don't let go.
It's coming. Back up.
I'll watch it. You watch ahead.
I won't be more than two steps off.
Your torch — a little left.
It's gone round the other side.
Listen. It's stopped.

lines.zh: 我在你后面半步，别回头。
lines.en: I'm half a step behind. Don't turn.
You fall back; I step up.
Count to three and we both move.

lines.zh: 它往你那边去了，我绕过去。
lines.en: It's gone your way. I'll circle round.
I've threads left. Enough.
I stand in front and take it.
I've pushed it off. Get back.
I catch its leg and hold it.
Strike it from beside me.
It's turned. Now's your moment.
Don't mind me. Hit it.
That put it half a step back.
I'm driving it to the doorway.
Leave your back to me.
That took every thread I have.
You called, so I came.
I stand in the doorway until you look.

lines.zh: 我从箱子里出来，抖了抖布。
lines.en: I climb out of the box and shake my cloth.
You said to follow, so I follow.
First time I've been here.

lines.zh: 我在你侧边站好，不动了。
lines.en: I settle at your side and hold.
My threads hang from my cuff.

lines.zh: 你走的时候，记得带上我。
lines.en: When you go, take me along.

lines.zh: 楼下那些人，我都躲开了。
lines.en: I slipped past the people downstairs.

lines.zh: 我把灯关了，免得有人看见。
lines.en: I turned the lights off so no one would see.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸你留下的东西。
lines.en: I touched what you left behind.

lines.zh: 我在这儿坐了一晚上，等你。
lines.en: I sat here all night waiting for you.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的袖子，我先护住你。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve; I cover you first.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上滚下去，又爬上来。
lines.en: I tumble down the steps and climb back.

lines.zh: 水没到我的腰，我伸手朝你。
lines.en: Water to my waist. I reach for you.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀开，我爬回你脚边。
lines.en: The blast throws me off. I crawl back to your feet.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我，我挡在你前面。
lines.en: Something pierces me. I was in front of you.

lines.zh: 有股力按住我，我挣着要起来。
lines.en: A force pins me; I strain to rise.

lines.zh: 我不用吃东西，你别分给我。
lines.en: I don't need food. Don't share yours.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我，我的线全直了。
lines.en: Lightning runs through me and my threads go straight.

lines.zh: 我一直往下掉，抓不到你。
lines.en: I fall and fall, and can't reach you.
